definitions.meaning: Happy from what one recollects (?), having happy memories (?). The word, however, glosses memoriale

source_text: gemynd-blíþe; adj. Happy from what one recollects (?), having happy memories (?). The word, however, glosses memoriale :-- Gemynd-blíþe memoriale, Ps. Spl. T. 101, 13.
